title: GPOM Banks
heading: GitPush Origin Master ▲ the banks
moodboard_intro: The opening's rooms, emptied, then the government reads the machine's script. Dashed cards are the opening as it is now. Tap This, Maybe or No; leave a note per beat.
storyboard_intro: Frames in story order. Pick one still and one way to animate each.

beats.name: The signal goes in
beats.blurb: Kept: the cable rush and the chip board. Round 2: five or six more 'photon' plates to cut in amongst the other scenes.

beats.name: The takeover
beats.blurb: Kept: the tower turning invader. Bolder: six towers flip, one per beat. Under 'friendly acquisition'.

beats.name: The CEO's window, from outside
beats.blurb: Proposed extra callback: the one lit office in the tower, now empty. Opens 'the government has welcomed…'.

beats.name: The CEO's office, empty
beats.blurb: He's gone. The champagne bottle is empty. The laptop: TRANSFERRING COMPANY FUNDS (text added in post).

beats.name: The trader's desk, empty
beats.blurb: Screens dead, the sandwich mouldy, the phone off the hook.

beats.name: The boardroom, empty
beats.blurb: HEADCOUNT 0 where it said -200,000. Empty chairs, flat champagne.

beats.name: The trading floor, empty
beats.blurb: The most important one, last and longest. The laughing traders' room with nobody in it; the board: TRANSFERRING MARKET FUNDS.

beats.name: The empty exchange
beats.blurb: New. A modern New York-style exchange floor, nobody in it, the boards still running (words in post). Lands on 'actually good for the markets'.

beats.name: The government's prompter
beats.blurb: The scene's last shot, on 'wishes to stress…its own idea'. First person, no hands. Blank glass for the speech and the machine's aside. The press pack is an array of cameras and microphones, no humans. Both glass types.
